summary.text: Matt Deneen is a Republican state senator who has represented District 10 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Matthew Deneen graduated from Elizabethtown High School, earned a bachelor's degree in secondary education and business from Georgetown College, and earned a master's degree in counseling from Western Kentucky University.
His career experience includes working as a teacher with Hardin County Schools.
He has served on the city council of Elizabethtown, as chairman of the Elizabethtown Trail Town Advisory Board, and on the board of Greenspace.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection Committee and serves on the Agriculture, Families and Children, and Judiciary committees.
